2.name: RESET#
2.hint: active-low reset, push-pull (CMOS): low while VCC is below VTH and for the reset timeout (140–460 ms) after it rises above; high VOH ≥ 0.8 × VCC – it drives up to its own supply (pin description p. 3, electrical characteristics p. 5, ordering table 'Push-Pull RESET')

hints: MAX809M: reset threshold VTH 4.38 V typ, 4.31–4.45 V at 25 °C, 4.27–4.49 V at −40 … 85 °C (p. 4) – a 5 V rail that dips to 4.5 V is close to it
the RESET output is push-pull to VCC: on a 3.3 V reset input of a part fed from another rail it drives above that part's supply
sources: onsemi MAX809 Series, MAX810 Series data sheet MAX809S/D, Rev. 28 (November 2017) – LCSC product data of C233679, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/97e1ce06744f3e988c8a05a94a63dcc3.pdf?productCode=C233679, read 2026-11-03 (edakit part fetch)
pins: p. 1 pin configuration SOT-23 – 1 GND, 2 RESET (MAX809, active low), 3 VCC; pin description p. 3
absolute maximum ratings p. 3: VCC −0.3 … 6.0 V, RESET output (CMOS) −0.3 … VCC + 0.3 V, input current VCC 20 mA, output current RESET 20 mA, RθJA 301 °C/W (SOT-23), operating junction −40 … +125 °C

electrical characteristics pp. 4–5: VCC range 1.2 … 5.5 V (−40 … 105 °C); ICC 0.8 typ / 1.8 mA max at 5.5 V (−40 … 85 °C); MAX8xxMTR VTH 4.38 V (4.31–4.45 V at 25 °C, 4.27–4.49 V at −40 … 85 °C); MAX809 VOH ≥ 0.8 VCC, VOL ≤ 0.3 V; reset timeout 140–460 ms (ordering information: MAX809MTRG 4.38 V, 140–460 ms, marking SPV)
icc_a 1.8 mA: ICC max at VCC 5.5 V
state high: the output above VTH – the operating state; the model does not follow VTH
mpn, manufacturer, footprint, jlc_class, pin numbers and names: EasyEDA library data of C233679 (edakit part import, 2026-11-03)
notes: Voltage supervisor: holds the ESP32's EN low while +5V is below 4.38 V. The schematic's value is 'MAX809M' (its symbol is KiCad's TPS3839DBZ); onsemi's MAX809MTRG stands in.

verified.datasheet: onsemi MAX809 Series, MAX810 Series data sheet MAX809S/D, Rev. 28 (November 2017)
checked: SOT-23 pinout p. 1: 1 GND, 2 RESET, 3 VCC = EasyEDA symbol
absolute maximum and electrical characteristics as in sources
MAX809: active-low push-pull output (CMOS, VOH ≥ 0.8 VCC)
open: the behaviour model 'logic' holds RESET high in every scenario; the threshold is not modelled
r_out_ohm: the data sheet gives VOH only at 500 µA – the model's default 50 Ω
